title: Tandem t:Slim X2 integration?
symptom: A parent wants to connect to a Tandem t:Slim X2 pump to pull bolus/basal/Basal-IQ/Control-IQ information and sync it to xDrip followers and Nightscout/Tidepool. Currently there is no working xDrip integration with the Tandem t:Slim X2.
cause: Tandem had not opened the pump to the DIY community, and a BLE capture suggested that the Tandem app applies another layer of encryption/obfuscation on top of the normal BLE protocol layer, making direct integration very difficult.
fix: No code change was made in xDrip; the maintainer closed the issue stating xDrip cannot be changed to enable this. The workaround discussed is to use the external tconnectsync project to synchronize data from the t:connect Android app to Nightscout, optionally running it in Docker with the auto-update feature enabled.
evidence_quote:
As discussed above,  @jwoglom has done a brilliant job of creating a synchronizer between the tconnect mobile app and nightscout. Found here... 
https://github.com/jwoglom/tconnectsync
